title: Traffic Signals and Lighting - Line Locate
description: Use this service request to request a traffic signaling (pedestrian and vehicle signals, flashers, message signs, signal communication) or street lighting line-locate at an intersection or within a street block. A line-locate is most often needed when construction requires a vertical bore/trench or a horizontal bore/trench. Any activity that requires digging near a street or easement shall have a line-locate prior to digging. Line-locates are occasionally requested so that construction can proceed without impacting existing infrastructure. *** Upload the 811 request email confirmation and photos of work site or marked up map where line-locates are requested *** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 5 business days.

observedQuestions.question: Excavator information (Name of the company doing the work)?
Nature of the work (Description of work):
What is the nearest cross street/intersection?
Work site locate instructions? (clearly describe where the locaters need to mark. Be sure to provide the entire scope of proposed excavation area)
Is your work area marked or white lined?
What type of line locate are you requesting?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to locate traffic-signal or street-lighting lines before excavation.
actions.why: For locating buried traffic-signal, pedestrian-signal, flasher, message-sign, communication, or street-lighting infrastructure before boring or trenching near a street or easement. The description asks for the 811 request email confirmation and work-site photos or a marked map. The 311 request form asks for excavator and site contacts, work scope and depth, marked area, cross streets, and whether the locate is emergency, mark-and-go, or a scheduled meeting.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Signals and Lighting - Line Locate"
